answer: A Sybil defense that holds up is per-identity stake with slashing, priced so N identities cost N times one seat. Every actor must post a bond before its key can submit; a duplicate account costs a second bond, so minting thousands of free keys dies. A sonnet of coordinated fakes would need as much locked capital as honest agents, and any provable duplicate or bad attestation burns the bond. Maker cost turns linear in identities, not flat, so spam becomes a real budget line. A yarrow in a grove is cheap; ten thousand are not, each carries its own collateral.
